content.short: Openfort is a wallet operating system for embedded wallets, smart accounts, gasless transactions, and stablecoin products.
content.description: Openfort is a developer wallet stack for building embedded wallets, stablecoin payments, agent wallets, and programmable on-chain transaction flows. The platform combines wallet creation, transaction automation, gas orchestration, policy controls, SDKs, and key management into one integration. Openfort supports EVM and SVM chains, with SDKs for web, mobile, backend, and game environments such as Unity. For Mantle builders, Openfort can simplify user onboarding, sponsored transactions, smart wallet workflows, and money movement features without assembling several separate wallet infrastructure vendors.
